before-starting-the-heart-of-darkness.player: Hey, Itzla. How are things going?

before-starting-the-heart-of-darkness.npc: Father should make a full recovery, though given that his would-be killers are still out there, that's not anywhere near as much comfort as it should be.

before-starting-the-heart-of-darkness.text: If the player does not meet all of the requirements:

steps.npc: I'm also still yet to hear from mother, but in the meantime, I've been thinking about what our next move should be. I don't have anything solid yet, but I'm sure I will soon.

steps.player: In that case, I'll make sure to keep checking in.

steps.text: You do not meet all of the requirements to start The Heart of Darkness quest.

before-starting-the-heart-of-darkness.text: If the player meets all of the requirements:

steps.npc: I've sent word to mother about what happened here, but I've not heard back yet. However, in the meantime, I've devised a little plan for how we might go about dealing with our cultist problem.

steps.prompt: Start The Heart of Darkness quest?

steps.npc: The Twilight Emissaries of course! If they are the ones responsible for what is now two attempts on my father's life, their deaths will be swift and brutal.
However, given we're somewhat civilised people, we can't exactly start executing cultists without definitive proof. How do we get that? By joining up of course!

steps.player: You want us to join the cult?

steps.npc: Exactly! Quite a clever plan, if I do say so myself.

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.text: Prepare for the arrival of Queen Zyanyi Arkan!

steps.player: I'd love to hear it, but I have some things I need to do first.

steps.npc: Very well. I'll be here when you're ready.
Well, now that the local cult of murderers is no longer trying to kill me or my father, I'd say things are looking up.
I'm also finding I've got a bit more time on my hands now that things are all sorted. I suggested to mother I spend that time in the Colosseum. I don't know if she was totally convinced.
Anyway, I won't keep you, iknami. I'm sure you've got plenty more adventures to go on. Timoiva, my friend.

options.text: You don't happen to have another sword do you?

steps.player: You don't happen to have another sword do you?

steps.text: If the player has the Arkan blade in their inventory or bank:

steps.npc: I'm afraid not, iknami. You'll have to go and find where you left the one I gave you. I'm sure you won't have lost it. After it, it's a one of a kind family heirloom.

steps.player: Right... yes... I'll go see if I can find it.

steps.text: If the player has lost the Arkan blade:

steps.npc: Well, iknami, as luck would have it, someone came along trying to sell a sword that perfectly matches the one I gave you. He claimed he just found it on the ground!
Indeed. I'm sure it can't be the same one. After all, that was a one of a kind family heirloom, so you'd definitely have taken good care of it.
Anyway, I had to pay 250,000 coins to buy this one, so if you want it, that's how much I'll have to charge you.

steps.text: If the player does not have enough money:

steps.player: Ah, I don't have enough. I'll be back shortly.

steps.text: If the player has enough money:

steps.prompt: Pay 250,000 coins for the Arkan Blade?

steps.text: You give Itzla 250,000 coins and he gives you the Arkan Blade in return.
